$comment: Provenance for data/symbols/. Hand-written, unlike flags.json which tools/audit_flag_licenses.py regenerates -- there are 28 symbols, not 214, and most are the project's own work. Every entry sourced from Wikimedia Commons must name its licence and any obligation, on the same terms the flags are held to: see data/licenses/FLAGS.md for why that discipline exists.

own_work.$comment: Project's own SVGs, carrying no third-party obligation. Those marked 'drawn' are produced by tools/generate_symbols.py; the rest are hand-authored paths. The reason each is not taken from Commons is recorded here and in that tool. There is no generic eagle.svg: it did not read as a bird and no Commons candidate survives nanosvg, so the symbol was removed.

files.circle_stars: drawn: the Commons version uses <use> and rendered blank
files.crescent: own path with a real cut-out; Commons version is CC BY-SA for no gain
files.diamond: trivial shape; Commons version carries <use> and <text>
files.fasces: Commons file uses gradient+filter, renders unreadable
files.gear: own evenodd path with a real hub hole
files.hammer_sickle: drawn: the Commons version uses a gradient
files.rose: drawn: the Commons version rendered as a solid blob
files.sun_wavy: Commons heraldic suns are detailed linework
files.swastika: drawn: geometric; censored in game either way
files.sword: drawn: Commons search surfaced militant-group flags, not a symbol
files.torch: drawn: Commons candidates are detailed linework
files.tree: drawn: Commons candidates are detailed linework
files.cross_saltir: drawn: the Commons version was CC BY-SA 3.0 and filled only 56% of its box, so it rendered visibly smaller than every symbol beside it. Redrawing it fills the box and removes the set's only share-alike obligation
files.star7: drawn: no file ever existed, so SymbolType::STAR_7 rendered nothing
files.wreath: drawn: Commons wreaths are heraldic linework that rasterises to noise at flag size
files.hammer: drawn: head and haft, canted so it does not read as a letter T
files.lightning: drawn: one polygon, which is all a bolt needs
files.sun_splendour: drawn: straight rays, as against sun_wavy's
